name: Dungeons & Heroines -Fushigi no Meikyuu to Ikai no Shoujo-
original_name: ダンジョンズ＆ヒロインズ -不思議の迷宮と異界の少女-
source:
Aizawa Eiri is an ordinary girl, but in online games she is a famous player known as "Swordsman Airi". One day she was suddenly summoned to a different world. In this world evil dragon has been sealed for ages and mages were summoned from everywhere to prevent his revival. 

Edited from DMM
translation:
相泽英梨是一个普通的女孩，但在网络游戏中她是一位被称为“剑客爱梨”的著名玩家。有一天，她突然被召唤到异世界。在这个世界上，邪龙已经被封印了很多年，各地的法师们都被召唤来阻止他的复活。

编辑自DMM
